verdict.rationale: Fleet monitoring is a fair question for a robotics framework, but the evidence shows no first-party multi-robot fleet dashboard. The pack documents only developer building blocks: topics for robot status, CLI introspection, topic statistics, and RViz in the desktop install. None of these is a single dashboard showing health, location, and status across a whole fleet.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can monitor the health, location, and status of a whole robot fleet from one dashboard
